tools.name: project.inspect
tools.description: Inspect the evaluations and project keys available in the authenticated organization.

tools.name: project.plan
tools.description: Return a non-mutating next-step plan for connecting a repository, evaluation, or trace source.

tools.name: evaluations.list
tools.description: List evaluations with a stable cursor for the organization.

tools.name: runs.list
tools.description: List evaluation runs with stable cursors and regression signals.

tools.name: run.explain
tools.description: Explain a run using its status, failed-case metadata, and evidence-lineage summary.

tools.name: baseline.lineage
tools.description: Show the published baseline anchor and its evidence lineage.

tools.name: docs.search
tools.description: Search the published OpenAPI operation catalog for relevant help.

tools.name: connector.health
tools.description: Show the latest connector-readiness reports for the organization.

tools.name: connections.list
tools.description: List current workspace connection metadata, with source restrictions, freshness and bounded continuation. Does not reveal secrets or grant source access.

tools.name: connections.catalog
tools.description: Inspect all connector definitions and exact installed setup paths. Unavailable blueprints and live verification are separate facts.

tools.name: connections.roots
tools.description: Page independent configured account roots using current administrator authority. Does not list secrets or imply verified connector availability.

tools.name: connections.graph
tools.description: Read canonical connection references and currently visible exact resource revisions. No source access grant or execution.
